entities.name: Empiricism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Philosophical doctrine emphasizing that knowledge comes primarily from sensory experience and observation rather than innate ideas or pure reason. Championed by Bacon and Locke, it became the epistemological foundation of modern science.
